北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 -3℃，添衣保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like -3℃. Dress warmly and stay cozy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 13℃，舒适宜人。出门愉快！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like 13℃, a lovely day. Enjoy your day out!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海体感 13℃，阳光明媚。注意防晒，心情美美！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 13℃ and is sunny. Don't forget sunscreen, have a lovely day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 21℃，阳光灿烂，很舒适，多喝水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels like 21℃, sunny and pleasant. Remember to hydrate!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 20℃，晴朗宜人，微风和煦。适合出行！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels like 20℃, lovely and sunny. A gentle breeze, perfect for going out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾，体感 14℃，出门记得戴口罩哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has haze and feels like 14℃. Remember to wear a mask when you go out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 13℃，晴空万里。暖暖的，祝你一天好心情！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like 13℃, clear and sunny. Warm and pleasant. Have a great day!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 12℃。气温适宜，记得多喝水！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 12℃. The temperature is mild, remember to hydrate!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 15℃。湿度高，注意保暖，别感冒哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and feels like 15℃. High humidity, keep warm and don't catch a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 7℃，有点凉。天气干燥，记得补水！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels like 7℃, a bit cool. It's dry, remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，体感 12℃。湿度高，出门戴口罩！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze and feels like 12℃. High humidity, wear a mask when out!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -22℃，极寒。穿最厚衣服，注意防滑！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -22℃, extremely cold! Wear your warmest clothes and watch your step!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -19℃，寒风凛冽。多穿点，注意防冻哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -19℃, bitter cold. Bundle up and prevent frostbite!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明体感 11℃，阳光明媚。早晚温差大，别着凉！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels like 11℃ and is sunny. Big temperature difference, don't catch a cold!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 15℃，晴朗，海风阵阵。享受这美好时光！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels like 15℃ and is sunny, with sea breezes. Enjoy this wonderful time!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，体感 -6℃，风大。添衣慢行，注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and feels like -6℃, with strong winds. Dress warmly, walk slowly, and stay safe!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -13℃，风力较大。多穿衣，别被风吹感冒啦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -13℃, quite windy. Bundle up and don't catch a cold from the wind!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
